name: cRZFastCompression3::HasValidHeader (thiscall, ret 8: source, size)
notes: Hooked (RefPack table; reached from Decompress 0x9a9100, not yet run in-game). Refuses a size under 7 and an unrecognised signature at +4 (RefPack::RecognizeHeader), then asks the object's slot 6 and slot 7 (compressed and decompressed lengths, in that order) and accepts both <= 0x1000000. cRZFastCompression3_HasValidHeader runs original and ours against a fake vtable whose slots record their calls and return chosen lengths: 24000 cases (sizes around 7, signatures, answers around 0x1000000, call order and count) plus real streams. Mutation check: 9 mutants (size<8, size<6, < instead of <= on either length, either length unchecked, signature check dropped, slots swapped, limit 0x1000001), all killed. cRZFastCompression3_OurVTable additionally checks our vtable's slots 0 to 9 against the original's by number.
